r1-0.notes: Dreamy sleepy face, correct staff upright. Palm-up hand under the shell (not toward lens) - static camera. Small water loop around the staff head (not her head), tiny heart sparkle by face.

r1-1.notes: Strong reach toward lens (5 fingers), staff upright, cliffs/torii/steps. Wide-eyed open-mouth smile less sleepy than her portrait.

r1-2.notes: Over-saturated, pink robe, red-orange outline on shell, twisted ribbon shaft; weaker rendering.

r1-3.notes: Reach toward lens, staff diagonal with shell up-right (away), waterfalls. Open-mouth smile, eyes not sleepy.

r1-4.notes: Soft closed-mouth smile with half-lidded seafoam eyes, white hair to seafoam tips, top braid, shell hairpin with navy ribbons, pearl earrings, navy sash bow with pearl brooch; staff upright in hand, shell+pearl+tassels clean. Waving hand 5 fingers (zoom-checked). Torii in turquoise water, waterfalls, cliffs, islands.

r1-5.notes: Holds a loose shell with pearl in both hands; no staff - prop missing.

r1-6.notes: Closest expression/pose to portrait, but staff stands unheld beside her and face centre ~70% across (edge of the crop rule).

checklist.likeness: yes - white-to-seafoam hair, top braid, shell hairpin, sleepy seafoam eyes, dreamy smile, navy sash bow
